stops.name: Hoya San Miguel
stops.detail: The mountain has three cirques, which receive the name of hoyas; these are Hoya San Miguel, San Gaudioso, and Morca.

stops.name: Morca
stops.detail: Other secondary ones are San Juan, at 2283 m; Morca, at 2273 m; and Peña Negrilla, at 2171 m.
